limitations: Relative expected inflation diverges when true polarization itself tends to zero; absolute bias tends to zero.
Exact factor is not universal across arbitrary projected directed networks.
Cross-product estimator may be negative and needs independent forest replicas.
Literature inspection cannot establish publication priority or independent validation.
scientific_integrity.scope: Single three-person heterogeneous hyperedge for the exact bias factor; iid complete rooted forests for general correction.

title: Finite-forest polarization bias on a heterogeneous three-person group
